CITY OF HAWAIIAN GARDENS  Wednesday, July 26, 2023
PLANNING COMMISSION MINUTES  Regular Meeting, 6:00 PM

Axzel Roman, Vice Chairmember  Fabiola Hernandez,

  Grant Winford,
  Chairmember

  MINUTES
CALL TO ORDER

The Planning Commission meeting was called to order on Wednesday, July 26, 2023 at
6:01 PM.

FLAG SALUTE

The flag salute was led by Commissioner Rodriguez.

ROLL CALL
PRESENT

  Chairmember Winford
  Vice Chairmember Roman
  Commissioner Gonzalez
  Commissioner Rodriguez
ABSENT
  1 Commissioner Hernandez
Pablo Rubio, City Clerk, announced a quorum.

PUBLIC COMMENTS - GENERAL OR ITEMS ON OR OFF THE AGENDA

There were no Public Comments.

AGENDA ORGANIZATION
This is the time for the Planning Commission to discuss any changes in the order
of agenda items.

 A.  PUBLIC HEARING(S) / HEARING(s)
 1.  Recommendation to adopt Resolution No. 2023-003 - Recommending Planning
  Commission approval of Conditional Use Permit No. 2023-0025 to permit the
  operation of an adult day health care facility (Two Wing Health Services, Inc) and
  determine the project is exempt pursuant to Section 15061(b)(3) of the California

   Environmental Quality Act (CEQA).

  SUGGESTED ACTION: Approve Recommendation.

  Kevin Nguyen, Associate Planner II, provided the staff report.

  Vice Chair Roman spoke.

  Commissioner Rodriguez spoke.

  Kevin Nguyen, Associate Planner II, spoke.

  Commissioner Gonzalez spoke.

  Chair Winford spoke.

  Daniel Han, applicant, spoke.

  Yunjeong Choi, manager, spoke.

  Commissioner Gonzalez spoke.

  Commissioner Rodriguez spoke.

  Discussion ensued between Commissioner Rodriguez and Yunjeong Choi

  Chair Winford spoke.

  A motion was made by Vice Chairmember Roman and seconded by
  Commissioner Gonzalez, to approve recommendation and adopt Resolution No.
  2023-003.

  The Motion was carried by the following vote:
  AYES: 4; Winford, Roman, Gonzalez, Navarro
  NOES: 0
  ABSENT: 1 Hernandez
  RECUSE: 0;

  B.  CONSENT CALENDAR

 1.  WAIVE READING IN FULL OF ALL ORDINANCES AND RESOLUTIONS ON
  THE AGENDA

  That the Planning Commission waive reading in full of all ordinances and
  resolutions on the agenda and declare that said titles which appear on the public
  agenda shall be determined to have been read by title and further reading
  waived.

  SUGGESTED ACTION: Approve Recommendation.

  A motion was made by Commissioner Rodriguez, seconded by Vice
  Chairmember Roman, to approve recommendation.

  The motion was Carried by the following vote:

  AYES: 4; Winford, Roman, Gonzalez, Rodriguez
  NOES: 0;
  ABSENT: 1; Hernandez
  RECUSE: 0;

  Motion Carried: 4–0–1–0

 2.  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Planning Commission meeting
  of Wednesday, April 26, 2023.

  SUGGESTED ACTION: Approve Recommendation.

  Commissioner Gonzalez abstained from Agenda Item No. B-2.

  A motion was made by Chairmember Winford, seconded by Commissioner
  Rodriguez, to approve recommendation.

  The motion was Carried by the following vote:

  AYES: 3; Winford, Roman, Rodriguez
  NOES: 0;
  ABSENT: 1; Hernandez
  RECUSE: 0;

  Motion Carried: 3–0–1–0

  C.  DISCUSSION ITEM(S)

There were no Discussion Items.

 D.  ORAL STAFF REPORT(S)

There were no Oral Staff Reports.

 E.  ORAL COMMISSIONER REPORT(S)

Chair Winford welcomed newly appointed Commissioner Gonzalez.

Commissioner Gonzalez thanked the Council for the opportunity to serve on the
commission.

Vice Chair Roman thanked staff for an easy ADU process for the public.

Commissioner Rodriguez requested an update on pending projects (two gas stations);
welcomed Commissioner Gonzalez; announced that the Robert Canada Friendship
Pow Wow is August 19 - 20, 2023; and requested a reorganization of the Planning
Commission.

Elise McCaleb, Community Development Director, spoke.

 F.  ADJOURNMENT

The Planning Commission meeting was adjourned at 6:45 PM
